package.description: This extension allows LabChart for Windows data to be played as sound either in real time or after recording. Common examples where this might be useful are the play back of heart sounds, animal sounds, voice, or action potential spikes.

en-US.description: This extension allows LabChart for Windows data to be played as sound either in real time or after recording. Common examples where this might be useful are the play back of heart sounds, animal sounds, voice, or action potential spikes.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Audio Output

zh-CN.description: 该扩展功能允许将 LabChart for Windows 采集的数据实时或录制后以声音形式播放。此功能在回放心音、动物叫声、语音或动作电位峰等场景中尤为实用。
